annotations.title: Scan the live site for the journey map

description: Start a site scan for the Journey optimizer: Firecrawl maps the live site and reads up to 40 pages (no LLM), keeping each page's title, internal links and a content fingerprint, so get_journeys can find orphan, duplicate and deep pages. Optional baseUrl (the public https:// address; defaults to the one Mushi Mushi already knows) and projectId. Firecrawl reads the pages on its side, usually within a few minutes; each get_journeys call moves the scan on, so call it again in about two minutes. Returns { scan: { id, status, baseUrl, pageCount, error, createdAt, finishedAt }, next }. One scan at a time per app (409 SCAN_RUNNING) and at most one every 10 minutes (429 SCAN_TOO_SOON); NO_LIVE_URL when no address is known, UNSAFE_URL for a private address; viewers cannot scan. Uses the project's Firecrawl key. Write: it stores a scan; nothing in the app or repo changes.

baseUrl.description: The site's public https:// address; defaults to the one Mushi Mushi already knows

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)
